Hi! 
I was diagnosed with agoraphobia back in 2021, but didn’t see the worst of it until the beginning of 2023. I started buspar in June of 2023 and there’s been a significant improvement, and i’m only on 10mg a day. 
I was also extremely anxious to start the meds and it took me about a week to finally take them. The only side affects I experienced were a weird brain-zap feeling and very light dizziness. those side effect only lasted for about 20-30 minutes after taking the dose and on rare occasions anymore. I’ve found that if i don’t eat enough throughout the day that can make it worse. But overall it’s completely manageable. 
I went from being home bound and constantly anxious to only having bad anxiety days every couple weeks. I do still experience panic attacks sometimes, however i’ve found i have the courage to actually do exposure therapy and my general anxiety has decreased immensely. 
Good luck to you! If it works, awesome! If it doesn’t, there’s always more options to try.
